data.name: CR5_001
data.value: (So this is it. The Shattered Ruins.)

data.name: CR5_002
data.value: We're here... The expedition's final objective.

data.name: CR5_007
data.value: Welcome to the Shattered Ruins camp. Everyone's here, as planned.

data.name: CR5_008
data.value: Settle in. We have a lot to say to each other before we go in.

data.name: CR5_009
data.value: Look. The main entrance, over there. The dark veins running across the stone... they all lead downward, inside.

data.name: CR5_010
data.value: (The veins... Like the ones Tornadus spoke of. A shape beneath the world.)

data.name: CR5_012
data.value: Before we enter these ruins, I want to hear from each of you. Everything you've seen since the expedition began.

data.name: CR5_033
data.value: The fire dies down gently. The camp falls asleep at the foot of the Shattered Ruins.

data.name: CR5_034
data.value: Tomorrow, we go in. Do you feel that weight too? As if the whole expedition led here.

data.name: CR5_036
data.value: And whatever is at the bottom, {0}, we'll find it. Together. As always...

data.name: CR5_D02
data.value: (...And he fell asleep mid-sentence. I guess the day wore him out.)

data.name: CR5_037
data.value: The ruins watch over the sleeping camp. The night wraps around them.

data.name: CR5_038
data.value: (...A silhouette. A light. Who...[pause=15] who was that?)

data.name: CR5_039
data.value: (I keep seeing that shape... but I can't catch it.)

data.name: CR5_040
data.value: (She said something...[pause=10] about me. About what I've become.)

data.name: CR5_041
data.value: You're awake? You looked... elsewhere. Seems sleep didn't give everything back.

data.name: CR5_042
data.value: The sun rises over the ruins. The stone catches fire. It feels like they're watching us.

data.name: CR5_043
data.value: Day has broken, and with it, the last leg of our expedition. The Shattered Ruins await.

data.name: CR5_044
data.value: We go in together. We come out together. Whatever is at the bottom, we'll face it head-on.

data.name: CR5_045
data.value: So... here we go. The Shattered Ruins, here we come.

data.name: CR5_046
data.value: (Let's go. And whatever is in there, we'll face it.)

data.name: CR5_D03
data.value: (The ruins watch over us. Tomorrow, we'll pay them a visit.)

data.name: CR5_K01
data.value: Easy, easy... Don't get up all at once. You took quite a hit in there.

data.name: CR5_K02
data.value: I've laid out berries and poultices. You'll move when I say so, not before.

data.name: CR5_K03
data.value: The ruins turned you back. It happens to the best teams. What matters is you came back whole.

data.name: CR5_K04
data.value: We're not going back to the guild. We rebuild here, at camp. And we try again when you're ready.

data.name: CR5_K05
data.value: Ouch... The first room was already a wall. We weren't prepared enough, that's all.

data.name: CR5_K06
data.value: But we are now, {0}. We know what awaits. And we'll come back smarter.

data.name: CR5_K07
data.value: The ruins don't cut anyone slack. I needed three tries to reach the bottom. Falling is normal.

data.name: CR5_K08
data.value: Falling isn't what matters. It's what you do after. And you two look like the kind who get back up.

data.name: CR5_K09
data.value: Rest. Eat. Next time we go in with what we learned. The camp is ready, and so are we.

data.name: CR5_R01
data.value: There you are. In one piece—that's what matters. A retreat isn't a defeat: it's a decision.

data.name: CR5_R02
data.value: Welcome back to camp. Sit by the fire. We'll talk about what's next once you catch your breath.

data.name: CR5_R03
data.value: We went as far as we could today. The corridors were turning... bad. We chose to come back.

data.name: CR5_R04
data.value: Wise call. The ruins aren't going anywhere. They've waited a thousand years: they can wait one more night.

data.name: CR5_R05
data.value: What you saw in there, hold onto it. Each attempt brings you closer to what pulses at the bottom.

data.name: CR5_R06
data.value: You did right to come back. Me, I'd have gotten lost in the first corridor, no joke. Coming back isn't giving up.

data.name: CR5_R07
data.value: Besides, we have everything we need here: a fire, food, and the best team in the region. Tomorrow will be a better day.

data.name: CR5_R08
data.value: So here's the plan: we rest, we restock, and we try again when you're recovered. The Shattered Ruins won't make us back down.

data.name: CR5_M01
data.value: Not bad, for a makeshift camp. Who cooked this?

data.name: CR5_M02
data.value: That was me. Some berries, some roots, lots of trial and error. The recipe still needs work.

data.name: CR5_M04
data.value: Yum! I love expedition nights! We eat, we talk, and tomorrow we face ruins! Now THAT's guild life!

data.name: CR5_K10
data.value: It was Kino and Reinier who found you. They were two floors down when the ground shook. They dropped everything to bring you back.

data.name: CR5_K11
data.value: We carried you back, more or less. Next time, we'll go down together—like a real team.

data.name: CR5_E01
data.value: Kino, Reinier—you know these ruins better than anyone. Go ahead as scouts. Mark the first floors.

data.name: CR5_E02
data.value: If you find a passage, mark it. If you find danger, come back and tell us. No one goes down alone.

data.name: CR5_E03
data.value: Count on us. We'll leave marks where things go wrong. And we'll come back to show you.

data.name: CR5_E04
data.value: And if something stirs at the bottom, we'll come tell you before touching it. My rear mind insists on that.

data.name: CR5_E05
data.value: Hyko, you guard the camp. No one enters or leaves without my say-so. You're our eyes out here.

data.name: CR5_E06
data.value: Rin, Coco—you hold the base. Care, supplies, and a fire that never dies. This is where everyone comes back.

data.name: CR5_E07
data.value: And us, then? Do we just stay here, watching everyone else leave?

data.name: CR5_E08
data.value: You're the main team. You enter when you're ready. Not when a clock says so. And we cover you from here. That's how an expedition holds together.

data.name: CR5_E09
data.value: (Kino and Reinier already inside... We won't be alone in there.)

data.name: CR5_P01
data.value: Wait... Plum? PLUM?! But... what is she doing HERE?

data.name: CR5_P02
data.value: She's...[pause=10] already here.[pause=20] Settled in, with her pots.[pause=15] ...How?[pause=15] We just came down the mountain, she was behind us, and yet...

data.name: CR5_P03
data.value: Surprise! You didn't wait for me, so I took a shortcut. A tiny little shortcut. Don't ask me which one—it's a chef's secret.

data.name: CR5_P05
data.value: I have the guild's stew in a pot. It almost spilled three times. But it's here. And it's waiting for you tonight.

data.name: CR5_P10
data.value: (Plum is still here. Of course Plum is still here. I don't know why I'm still surprised.)

data.name: CR5_K12
data.value: Eat first. The stew is hot, it's been waiting since this morning. A full belly recovers faster than an empty one. That's the science of logistics.

data.name: CR5_R09
data.value: There we go. A well-handled retreat is already a victory. Want another bowl? There's enough for everyone. I always plan big.

data.name: CR5_047
data.value: The summit... We defeated the king of the skies, and now he sends us here. Do you realize? Everything we crossed to stand before this door.

data.name: CR5_048
data.value: (Tornadus said the veins converge toward the north. We're at the end of the thread. Or rather, at the start of something.)

data.name: CR5_T01
data.value: Honestly, Plum...[pause=15] you're acting like a real tsundere right now.

data.name: CR5_T02
data.value: WHAT?!

data.name: CR5_T03
data.value: N-NO!! H-H-HOW DARE YOU SAY THAT?!

data.name: CR5_T04
data.value: Hahaha![pause=10] She blushed![pause=0] She REALLY blushed!

data.name: CR5_T05
data.value: I... I'm not blushing![pause=0] It's the fire![pause=10] THE FIRE, do you hear me?!

data.name: CR5_T06
data.value: Alright, everyone to bed.[pause=15] Tomorrow, we enter the ruins.

data.name: CR5_T07
data.value: ...MAJESTIC Plum never sulks.[pause=10] She withdraws, strategically.

data.name: CR5_V01
data.value: Me, after the expedition...[pause=15] I want to see what lies beyond these ruins.[pause=0] The whole region.

data.name: CR5_V02
data.value: Me, I want to map everything we discover.[pause=15] So no one forgets.

data.name: CR5_V03
data.value: Me... a real kitchen, at the guild.[pause=15] Not just camp stews.

data.name: CR5_V04
data.value: A proper infirmary.[pause=15] Where you don't choose between healing and sleeping.

data.name: CR5_V05
data.value: Record everything.[pause=10] The ruins, the wind, the veins...[pause=15] One day, someone will read our notes.

data.name: CR5_V06
data.value: Protect Metano.[pause=15] It's simple.[pause=0] And it's already a mountain.

data.name: CR5_V07
data.value: Become an explorer people listen to.[pause=15] Like you.

data.name: CR5_V08
data.value: Me?[pause=10] ...Sleep.[pause=10] Eat.[pause=10] Start over.[pause=0] Not bad, right?

data.name: CR5_V09
data.value: See the sea.[pause=15] They say it has no end.[pause=0] I want to check.

data.name: CR5_V10
data.value: The guild.[pause=10] Growing it with all of you.[pause=15] That's my dream, and it's already underway.

data.name: CR5_V11
data.value: Become a team people remember.[pause=15] Like the ones in the stories.

data.name: CR5_V12
data.value: (Me... I still don't know my own dream.[pause=15] No memories from before...[pause=0] so no dream from before, either.)

data.name: CR5_W01
data.value: We finally made it past the mountain![pause=10] The wind is still pushing us.

data.name: CR5_W02
data.value: The ruins can't be far now.[pause=10] I can feel them... like a presence.

data.name: CR5_W03
data.value: Over there.[pause=10] Look, the stones sticking out.[pause=0] That has to be it.

data.name: CR5_W04
data.value: We're almost there.[pause=10] One more push, and we'll see what Tornadus was guarding.

data.name: CR5_X01
data.value: ...I'm not talking to anyone.[pause=10] Especially not to you.

data.name: CR5_X02
data.value: It's YOUR fault![pause=10] YOU LOST ME!

data.name: CR5_X03
data.value: Well...[pause=10] I didn't lose you...[pause=0] Nuance.

data.name: CR5_X04
data.value: Good thing ME...[pause=10] the great,[pause=0] the one and only...[pause=15] MAJESTIC Plum...[pause=0] was here!

data.name: CR5_X05
data.value: I made you an excellent dinner![pause=10] Everyone to the table![pause=0] ...By order of MAJESTIC Plum!

data.name: CR5_X06
data.value: Thank you, Plum.[pause=15] Really.[pause=0] ...We never see it coming, as usual.

data.name: CR5_X07
data.value: I knew she'd blow a fuse.[pause=10] Called it.

data.name: CR5_X08
data.value: A few hours later...

data.name: CR5_W05
data.value: By the way...[pause=10] Has anyone seen Plum since the mountain?

data.name: CR5_W06
data.value: Plum?[pause=10] ...She was right behind us a moment ago.[pause=15] I think.

data.name: CR5_W07
data.value: ...She beat us here.[pause=15] Again.[pause=0] Let's not ask how.[pause=10] Let's NEVER ask how.
